entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker hunter from Skalla who wields the Arkbow and travels to Luneau, where she is horrified by the vampires' cruelty and attacks them.

entities.name: Frederic
entities.description: A flirtatious vampire huntsman of Luneau who escorts Vivien to the capital and defends its customs.

entities.name: Marcois Jean-Jaquent
entities.description: A vampire noble who rules the Royal Menagerie and the Hall of Treasures; he catches Vivien after she disrupts the show and survives her stab wounds.

entities.name: King Lucard
entities.description: The gaunt-faced vampire king of Luneau.

entities.name: Queen Salazar
entities.description: The severe vampire queen of Luneau, who appears bored by the tableau.

entities.name: The pale noblewoman
entities.description: An alabaster-wigged vampire noblewoman with a beauty mark who speaks with Frederic about the gala.

entities.name: The brontodon
entities.description: A juvenile brontodon held captive aboard Frederic's ship for the Royal Menagerie.

entities.name: The monstrosaur
entities.description: A tortured monstrosaur with pulled teeth, displayed at the Tourdion gala; it survives chaos to crush a guard in triumph.

entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: Vivien's lost homeland, destroyed by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker whose destruction of Skalla Vivien recalls.

entities.name: The Arkbow
entities.description: A crooked, silver-sleeved bow, the last piece of Skalla, whose arrows summon glowing spectral beasts.

entities.name: Luneau
entities.description: The marble vampire island kingdom on Ixalan with the Perfumed Court, Royal Menagerie and Hall of Treasures.

entities.name: The Royal Menagerie
entities.description: A vast menagerie of captured wildlife run by the Baron of Vernot.

entities.name: The Hall of Treasures
entities.description: A hall of taxidermied extinct animals in Luneau.

entities.name: The Perfumed Court
entities.description: The perfumed aristocratic quarter of Luneau.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place, with dinosaurs and a Golden City.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire church that sees itself as caretaker of Ixalan.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A coalition of ruffian sailors that only accepts competent sailors.

entities.name: Vampires of Luneau
entities.description: The undead aristocracy of Luneau who drink mortal blood as a payment.

entities.name: Rite of Redemption
entities.description: The vampires' rite whose consequences force them to drink blood.

entities.name: Tourdion with the Truculent Thunder
entities.description: A famous Luneau gala at which tortured animals are displayed.

entities.name: The Pelakka wurm
entities.description: A spectral Pelakka wurm summoned from the Arkbow that devours guards.

entities.name: The hydra
entities.description: A spectral green hydra summoned from the Arkbow that kills nobles.

entities.name: Golden City
entities.description: A city on Ixalan that fears the monstrosaur.

events.summary: Vivien, aboard Frederic's ship, refuses to stow the Arkbow and expresses concern over the brontodon captive.
events.quote: There will be medical attention waiting for the brontodon, I hope?

events.summary: At the pier Vivien pins a human pickpocket who offers blood as penance, and Frederic offers her a dirk to take it.
events.quote: This is the currency of Luneau, mademoiselle.

events.summary: Vivien refuses the blood and frees the pickpocket, accusing Luneau of being a glorified abattoir.
events.quote: I'd say you were bullying this boy into accepting his lot as livestock

events.summary: Frederic claims Luneau preserves species, and Vivien tours the marble city with disgust.
events.quote: Preservation, mademoiselle. You never know when a species might go extinct.

events.summary: Frederic touches Vivien's wrist and asks about her home, and she recalls Skalla's destruction by fire.
events.quote: She tried not to think of fire.

events.summary: In the Hall of Treasures Vivien sees hundreds of taxidermied extinct species and wants to see it all gone, understanding Bolas for a moment.
events.quote: For one terrible moment, the Planeswalker could understand Nicol Bolas, the death of Skalla, the end of everything she'd known and loved.

events.summary: In the Perfumed Court, Frederic tells Vivien that the Baron of Vernot believes there are giants among the lizards, and the Arkbow urges Vivien to destroy Luneau, though she decides to wait.
King Lucard and Queen Salazar enter and the court bows, but Vivien stays unbowed.
events.quote: Alone of them, Vivien stood unbowed, chin tipped up.

events.summary: The Baron of Vernot, Marcois Jean-Jaquent, enters and calls his special guests.
At the Tourdion, performers torture lizards, bears, raptors and cranes, and Vivien protests.
The baron presents a new monstrosaur, tortured and with its largest teeth plucked.
events.quote: Someone, Vivien realized with a pang of horror, had plucked the largest teeth from its head.

events.summary: Vivien fires the Arkbow, summoning a spectral hydra that kills nobles and disrupts the gala.
events.quote: the seething, glimmering green outline of a hydra wrenched itself from the arrowhead and howled its hunger for the world to see.

events.summary: The wounded monstrosaur, forgotten amid the chaos, crushes a guard in triumph.
events.quote: And as it did, it screamed and this time, there was triumph in the noise.

events.summary: Vivien summons a Pelakka wurm that devours guards and a spectral stag that throws a guard into a wall.
events.quote: The Pelakka wurm launched itself forward, all mouth and sinuous body, glowing green.

events.summary: The Baron of Vernot confronts Vivien surrounded by crossbowmen, and Vivien calls the place an abomination.
Vivien vows to make Luneau pay and summons a swarm of giant wasps.
events.quote: I will see Luneau pay for what it has done to this world.

events.summary: Vivien stabs the baron with her daggers but he is unharmed, and he backhands her.
events.quote: But the baron's placid expression did not change.

events.summary: Vivien kicks and clubs the baron, but his minions drag her away; she knocks out two guards before losing consciousness.
events.quote: It was, she decided as awareness bled from her, at least a decent last stand.

relations.note: self-appointed escort who flirts with and condescends to her
relations.quote: Frederic, the vampire huntsman who'd elected himself her escort

relations.note: Vivien despises Luneau's cruelty and wants it gone
relations.quote: Together, they would see it gone.

relations.note: fights the baron after he shows the tortured monstrosaur
relations.quote: I will see Luneau pay for what it has done to this world.

relations.note: rules the Royal Menagerie and the Hall of Treasures
relations.quote: He rules over the Royal Menagerie and the wonders in the Hall of Treasures.
The sovereign rulers of Luneau tipped their heads
Vampires were eternal, both in habit and biology.

relations.note: Vivien links Bolas to the death of Skalla
relations.quote: the death of Skalla, the end of everything she'd known and loved.

relations.note: the Arkbow is the last piece of Skalla outside Vivien
relations.quote: the last piece of Skalla outside of her own skin and tendons.
